log.msg: built context_alert() in Agents.js, 'alert:' pointer in Follow.js, test context-alert.test.mjs; fixing worktree test boot, then doc + review

findings.text: The diff brings in work from another task: `Server/PromptGroup.test.mjs` (and, on branch qf-8, commits 34efefc58, 6edea540d, 1e1df1970 "prompt-grouping") sit on top of this task's one commit 56e6182ae. If you merge qf-8 as it stands, prompt-grouping lands too. Land only 56e6182ae (cherry-pick it onto a clean branch), or say in the task log that the two land together.

The branch was not rebased on `michael/dev`, though the brief asked for it: its merge-base is e4a8cb9b7, and dev is now at a79ff6227. A sibling minion (`minion-mastermind-path`) also edits Agents.js, so rebase and re-run the test before you call it ready.

Docs that list what wakes a parent are now stale. `Servex/Follow.js:64` (the comment just above the changed `POINTER` regex) still lists only `show:/ready:/wrote:`. `public/framework/ai/doc/task-buckets.md:49-59` (the table of what a session log holds and what reaches the parent) and `Servex/doc/follow.md:176` don't mention the new `alert:` pointer line either.

There is no record of how the task ended. `session.jsonl`'s last line is the minion's mid-task "fixing worktree test boot, then doc + review": no landing line, no outcome, no ready-to-merge report. A fresh agent can't tell from the folder whether `review.mjs` ran or what is left.

The alerts only fire for minions. `oversized()` (Agents.js:1599) force-compacts every role that has a `compact_after` at 400k, which is below 50% of the 1M window, so a task-mastermind child never reaches the first alert. That follows the brief, which keeps the thresholds, but one sentence about it belongs in `ai/doc/context.md`.

The brief asked to test the parent's real `follow` queue; the test calls `Follow.worth_waking` instead (`Servex/agents/context-alert.test.mjs:17`). That is the filter the queue applies (Follow.js:281, 314), so it is close enough. `child-follow.test.mjs` already exists and could carry the end-to-end check.

Some code is repeated. `context_alert()` (Agents.js:2298) builds the session-log path again, though `agent_log(agent)` (Agents.js:30) already computes exactly that. The window expression also appears for a third time (lines 1623, 1645, 2290); it could live in one `window()` method.

`context_alerted` lives only in memory, so a child resumed after a Servex restart, still above 50%, alerts its parent once more. That's harmless. The brief's "commit after each step" ended up as one commit, which is fine for a change this small.
